title: MakerVerse, The laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF) design guide
notes: Service-platform design guide dated 3 April 2024, read on 2026-11-12. It gives a rule of thumb for internal corners: a fillet of one quarter of the wall thickness of the feature, ribs or pins being its examples. For a 0.8 mm rib that rule gives 0.2 mm. It also states that surfaces below 45 degrees to the build plate need support and that layers are usually 20 to 80 micrometres. It names no alloy or machine for the fillet rule and states no minimum radius, no accuracy and no roughness. It is a design proportion, not evidence that a process holds the radius.
